description: A nested object-wrapped expression may omit spec_version.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person) RETURN $p0 AS seven $$, %s) AS ("seven" agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS ($p0 AS "seven"))

duck_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") COLUMNS ($p0 AS "seven"))
